audit_items.proof_trace: The first-borrow branch (L117-134) asserts `!self.ctokens.is_supporting_collateral<MarketType, CoinType>()` (L121-124), blocking any initial borrow of an asset already held as collateral. The complementary guard in `deposit_ctoken` (L86-89) prevents an already-borrowed asset from becoming collateral. These two guards jointly maintain the invariant that no obligation can have the same asset simultaneously in debts and ctokens, making the subsequent-borrow branch (L136-140, which lacks the collateral check) unreachable when collateral exists.
